name: OLMo
description:
Here is how to read the OLMo config.json. The architecture class is OLMoForCausalLM, which is the transformers (or equivalent) module that wires embeddings, attention, the MLP, and the language-modelling head that turns hidden states into next-token logits.

hidden_size is 4,096: that is the width of every residual stream vector. The embedding matrix is therefore 50,280 × 4,096: each token id owns a vector of that width.

vocab_size is 50,280. bos/eos ids, when present, are just two special rows in that table; the padded vocab is often larger than the tokenizer’s real inventory.

The copy of config.json is from https://huggingface.co/allenai/OLMo-7B/blob/main/config.json.
